rv.q: Indeed, in an era when many plays lack the kind of structure guaranteed to please an audience, “Georgiana & Kitty” is the very model of a well-made play.
Northlight Theatre offers another wonderful opportunity to spend Christmas at Pemberley.
It is a touching and entertaining drama about family relationships and the influence and importance of friendship.

I highly recommend this cheerful, funny, romantic show for audiences of all ages who would like to enjoy a pleasant evening revisiting some of the most beloved Jane Austen characters in a classic yet freshly presented production set in turn of the century London.
Ultimately, “Georgiana and Kitty” could be described as a celebration of female artists — and the female producers, promoters and directors who support them — wrapped up in a romance.
Nonetheless, the cast gives the material a lot of heart and “Georgiana and Kitty: Christmas at Pemberley” is a fun holiday diversion.
This performance of “Georgiana & Kitty: Christmas at Pemberley” was no exception.

cn.t: This charming finale to the "Christmas at Pemberley" trilogy delivers lighthearted Jane Austen fan fiction with impressive craft, engaging banter, and a welcome feminist twist that makes for delightful holiday entertainment.
